day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Saddex iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada!
homily:
Waxaa jira daqiiqado nolosha ah oo u muuqda kuwo aan la fahmi karin, sida marka aad eegto sawirka Ben oo si sharaf leh u taagan isagoo xidhan suudhkiisa buluugga ah, ama marka aad xasuusato sida uu ugu faraxsanaa inuu la socdo diyaaradaha. Waxaad sawiran kartaa wiil yar oo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan xikmad, isagoo si taxaddar leh u qorsheynaya mustaqbalka, isagoo ku riyoonaya 'Con Chim Airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu dunida u eego indho uu Ilaah ku arko. Maanta, akhriska koowaad, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Run so as to win.' – 'U orda si aad u guulaysataan.' Bawlos wuxuu ka hadlayaa tartanka nolosha, tartanka aan u ordno si aan u helno taaj aan ba'ayn. 

Ben wuxuu ahaa orod-yahan. Ma aha oo kaliya markuu badminton-ka ciyaarayay, laakiin noloshiisa oo dhan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan ka cabsanayn inuu dadaalo. Wuxuu ina baray in 'dadaalku uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah.' Laakiin Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ka qoto dheer: 'I drive my body and train it, for fear that, after having preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.' Tani ma aha cabsi ku saabsan guul-darro, laakiin waa xusuusin ku saabsan ujeeddada. Ben wuxuu lahaa ujeeddo. Wuxuu lahaa qalbi u furan dadka kale. Xusuusnow markuu rabay inuu siiyo lacagta sanduuqiisa yar adeerkiis William? Ma uusan jebin, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. 

Alan iyo Thao, laba bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale, June 13, 2026. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta idiin sheego si cad oo naxariis leh: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay xertiisa markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Xanuunka iyo dhimashada ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Waxaad Ben siiseen nolosha ugu quruxda badan ee waalid uu wiil siin karo. Jacaylkaaga, Alan, ee aad u sheegi jirtay sheekooyinka aad ku qosli jirteen, iyo taageeradaada, Thao, waxay ahaayeen nuurkii uu Ben ku koray. Waxaad ahaydeen waalidkii ugu fiicnaa. Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. 

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Why do you notice the splinter in your brother's eye, but do not perceive the wooden beam in your own?' Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan nafteena eegno ka hor intaanan eegin dadka kale. Laakiin xanuunka dhexdiisa, waxaan u janjeernaa inaan nafteena eedeyno. Waxaan u janjeernaa inaan raadino 'qoryo' ama khaladaad aanan samayn. Jooji eeddaas. Ilaah wuu ku jecel yahay, Ben-na wuu ku jecel yahay. Sida uu Ben u yidhi riyadii aad aragtay: 'Ba, ma aha wax dhib ah, waan ku daawanayaa.' 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay in labadan bilood ay adiga kugu adkaayeen. Waxaad weyday walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, iyo kii aad la wadaagi jirtay qolka iyo riyooyinka. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu yahay mid ku eegaya dhoolacaddayn. Sii wad inaad u noolaato si geesinimo leh, waayo xiriirka idinka dhexeeya ma go'in; wuxuu ku jiraa xiriirka quduuska ah ee salaadda. Sii wad inaad riyooto, sii wad inaad noolaato, waayo Ben wuxuu doonayaa inaad faraxsan tahay. 

Ceelka biyaha ee 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' ee Cà Mau waa calaamad muujinaysa in naxariistii Ben ay weli u qulqulayso sidii biyo nadiif ah oo kale, iyadoo quudinaysa dadka oomman. Magaciisa 'Đại Dương' oo macnaheedu yahay Badweyn Weyn wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in naxariista Ilaah ay ka ballaaran tahay murugo kasta. Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada kaliya markaad dhex joogto xanuunka. U dhiib shabaggaaga gacmaha Rabbiga. U ogolow Ciise inuu kula socdo. Benjamin, wiilkaygii qaaliga ahaa, noo ducee. Noo ducee annaga oo halkan joogna, si aan u helno xoog aan ku sii soconno, illaa aan mar kale kulanno oo aan aragno dhoolacaddayntaada quruxda badan albaabka Jannada. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horeyba u joogtay, waxaana naftayda u midaynayaa adiga. Waligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u baryeynaa Ben iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka Masiixu uu weligiis bixiyo.
Waxaan u baryeynaa dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, in Ilaah uu qalbi-qaboojiyo oo uu siiyo rajo cusub.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow, haddii aan Injiilka wacdiyo, taasu sabab aan ku faano ma aha, waayo, waajib baa lay saaray, waana u hoogay haddii aanan Injiilka wacdin! Haddii aan si ikhtiyaar ah u sameeyo, waxaan leeyahay abaalgud, laakiin haddii aan si qasab ah u sameeyo, waxaa laygu aaminay wakiilnimo. Haddaba waa maxay abaalgudkaygu? Waa inaan, markaan wacdiyo, Injiilka bixiyo bilaash si aanan u isticmaalin xaqayga Injiilka. In kastoo aan dadka oo dhan ka xor ahay, haddana waxaan isu dhiibay addoon dadka oo dhan si aan u kasbado intii suurtogal ah. Waxaan noqday wax walba dadka oo dhan, si aan u badbaadiyo ugu yaraan qaar. Waxaas oo dhan waxaan u sameeyaa Injiilka aawadiis, si aan aniguna qayb uga helo. Miyaadan ogayn in kuwa garoonka ku ordaya ay dhammaantood ordaan, laakiin mid keliya uu guulaysto? Sidaas u orda si aad u guulaysataan. Orod kastaa wuxuu u tababartaa si adag dhinac kasta. Waxay u sameeyaan si ay u helaan taaj dhimanaya, laakiin annagu waxaan u samaynaa mid aan dhimanayn. Sidaas darteed, uma ordi si aan ujeeddo lahayn; uma dagaallamo sidii qof hawada u dharbaaxaya. Maya, waxaan tababaraa jirkayga, waayo waxaan ka baqayaa in ka dib markaan dadka kale wacdiyay, aniguna aan noqdo mid aan u qalmin.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada! Naftaydu way u ooman tahay oo u dhibaataysan tahay barxadaha Rabbiga. Qalbigayga iyo jidhkaygu waxay u qaylinayaan Ilaaha nool. R. Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada! Xataa shimbirta yar waxay heshaa hoy, iyo qoolleydu buul ay ilmaheeda dhigato—meelahaaga allabariga, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada, Boqorkaygiiyow iyo Ilaahaygiiyow! R. Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada! Barakaysan yihiin kuwa gurigaaga deggan! Waxay mar walba ku ammaanaan. Barakaysan yihiin kuwa xooggoodu adiga yahay! Qalbigoodu wuxuu saaran yahay socdaalka. R. Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada! Waayo, Rabbiga Ilaah waa qorrax iyo gaashaan; nimco iyo ammaan buu bixiyaa; Rabbigu wax wanaagsan kama celiyo kuwa ku socda daacadnimo. R. Sidee bay u qurux badan yihiin meelahaaga hoyga ah, Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammada!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa u sheegay masaal: "Indhooluhu ma indhoolaha kale ayuu hoggaamin karaa? Miyaanay labaduba god ku dhici doonin? Xertu macallinka kama sarrayso; laakiin markay si buuxda u tababartaan, xertiiba waxay noqon doonaan sidii macallinkooda. Maxaad u aragtaa qaybta yar ee isha walaalkaa ku jirta, laakiin aadan u dareemayn tiirka alwaaxa ah ee ishaada ku jira? Sidee baad ugu dhihi kartaa walaalkaa, 'Walaalow, ii oggolow inaan qaybta yar ishaada ka saaro,' adigoon dareemayn tiirka alwaaxa ah ee ishaada ku jira? Munaafaq yahow! Marka hore tiirka alwaaxa ah ishaada ka saar; ka dibna waxaad si cad u arki doontaa inaad qaybta yar isha walaalkaa ka saarto."

day: Friday of the Twenty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: can't stop thinking about you Ben... wishing i could go back into time and try to change things around... maybe spend more time with you and less working so much. Please pray for me and mom.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you Ben - haven't been able to sleep much these days. Please stop by to say hi whenever you're able to. Love you
